name: pwdev-excalidraw
description: Visual planning with Excalidraw diagrams through an MCP server, portable across Claude Code and Codex.

interface.longDescription: Create and review editable Excalidraw diagrams for architecture, user flows, dependencies, roadmaps, decisions, and risks. The skill is runtime-neutral and uses the configured Excalidraw MCP server when available.
defaultPrompt: Create an Excalidraw architecture diagram for this plan.
Visualize the user flow and dependencies without changing code.
Review this proposal visually and highlight risks and unknowns.
